patches.name: memory-search-half-life
patches.note: Memory search temporal-decay half-life 365 days instead of the hard-coded 30 (see DOCS.md, "Memory search recency"; 2026.11.1 still hard-codes 30 days). Since 2026.10.10 minScore is checked before the decay (openclaw/openclaw#168692), so the half-life only sets the ranking (and with it which eligible hits fit into the returned maxResults, default 6). Same diff as oc-patches/2026.10.10, at the same line.

patches.name: telegram-voice-text-first
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (1/3): a single voice reply whose text exceeds the caption limit sends and confirms the text first, then the audio without caption; a network failure or voice-privacy rejection of the audio keeps the text and is not retried. Same diff as oc-patches/2026.10.10 (re-derived there from 2026.10.4: no needsSeparateText, the logger is sendLogger); extensions/telegram/src/send-message.ts is unchanged in 2026.11.1.

patches.name: telegram-delivery-live-custody
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (2/3): a process-local refcount per sessionId/intentId is held from the start of a direct reply delivery until its canonical settlement (also across deferred finalization). Same diff as oc-patches/2026.10.10 (local names voltLive and attempt.voltReleaseLive, because deliverReply has its own custody/releaseCustody); src/channels/turn/lifecycle.ts is unchanged in 2026.11.1.

patches.name: telegram-notice-live-guard
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (2/3): the pending-delivery notice ("I couldn’t confirm whether my previous reply reached this chat ...") skips an intent that is still being delivered; settled unknown outcomes and restart debts are still reported. Same diff as oc-patches/2026.10.10; pending-delivery-notice.ts is unchanged in 2026.11.1.

patches.name: telegram-fetch-fresh-audio
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (3/3): sendVoice/sendAudio use a fresh connection like sendMessage, with the same rule that a request Telegram may have received is not replayed (isSafeToRetrySendError). Same diff as oc-patches/2026.10.10; extensions/telegram/src/fetch.ts is unchanged in 2026.11.1.
